title: Ansel and the Salt
author: Beatrix Hartwell
blurb: Rosalind Eastwick, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
